verdict.rationale: Resend's docs say users can 'build recurring flows with automations' for marketing email. Broadcasts can be scheduled to send later, and webhooks give event-driven triggers for delivery and inbound email that could drive background workflows. The automations feature itself gets only a single one-line mention, so the evidence is thin, and these pieces mostly need the user's own code to run unattended. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the automations feature (triggers, steps, conditions), any agent-driven or AI-configured autonomous workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration that automations run reliably in the background.
